threat_event: Attacker takes over the online store administrator account and adds a script or checkout change that shows shoppers a fake card form before the redirect (e-commerce skimming)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the store admin account; password reused from email; custom code setting and add-ons never reviewed; no monitoring of store changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 online store; SYS-02 hosted payment page; BP-02
existing_controls: Checkout redirects to the processor; promotional pop-up add-on removed 2026-08-12
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA and a unique passphrase; keep custom code empty and add-ons off checkout; monthly activity check; P08 runbook

threat_event: Phone-order card numbers with expiration dates and security codes on the paper pad are stolen from the drawer or recovered from the trash and used for fraud
threat_source: Thief or dumpster diver; anyone at the counter
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card data and security codes written down and kept after authorization; unlocked drawer; regular trash
existing_controls: 23 pages shredded 2026-08-11; card details now keyed while the customer is on the line
treatment_plan: Never write card data; cross-cut shredder for any paper with customer details; locked drawer; check the pad weekly

threat_event: A device on the shared store Wi-Fi (a customer's phone or the shared laptop) attacks the card terminal or the tablet, or the router is taken over through its default password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One flat network for the terminal, owner devices, cameras, and customers; Wi-Fi password posted; router admin password is the label default
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 network; SYS-02 terminal; SYS-03 tablet
existing_controls: ISP router blocks unsolicited inbound traffic; terminal encrypts card data to the processor
treatment_plan: Change router and Wi-Fi passwords; guest network for customers; separate network for the terminal; check router firmware yearly

threat_event: Takeover of the personal email account exposes customer exports and order notices and is used to reset the online store password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on email; same password as the online store; business and personal mail mixed
treatment_plan: MFA now; unique passphrase in a password manager; move the business to a separate business email account by 2026-12-31

threat_event: Skimmer overlay or swapped terminal at the counter, or PIN entry captured by the camera above the register
threat_source: Organized card skimming crew; camera account intruder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminal never inspected and serial number unrecorded; family member not trained; camera view covers the keypad
existing_controls: PCI PTS-approved terminal in view of the register
treatment_plan: Record the serial number; daily opening inspection with a checklist; show the family member what to look for; re-aim the camera away from the keypad

threat_event: Unauthorized refunds or voids through the shared POS PIN or the terminal's default manager password
threat_source: Insider or someone who read the quick-start guide
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared POS PIN; terminal manager password was the factory default until 2026-08-13
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 POS app; SYS-02 terminal; BP-01
treatment_plan: Separate POS user for the family member; refunds only with the owner's password; monthly refunds report check

threat_event: Malware or ransomware on the shared family laptop, or theft of the laptop, exposes customer exports and the store and portal sessions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptop shared with family; owner uses an administrator account; no full-disk encryption; customer exports stored locally
treatment_plan: Full-disk encryption; separate standard account for family; owner uses a standard account for daily work; delete old exports

threat_event: Customer names, emails, and order histories pasted into a consumer AI chatbot are kept or used for training by the vendor, contrary to the store's privacy notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer terms; training on chats was on; privacy notice says customer data is never shared
existing_controls: Customer data stopped going to the chatbot 2026-08-24
treatment_plan: Training off; chat history deleted; no customer data in any AI tool; correct the privacy notice (P10)

threat_event: AI-suggested price changes raise prices during a declared state of emergency or give SNAP EBT customers different prices or terms than cash customers
threat_source: Owner error with an AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Price suggestions applied without a written check; no emergency freeze rule
existing_controls: Owner sets shelf prices by hand in the POS app
treatment_plan: Human price check with a cost floor and a 10% weekly change cap; freeze increases during declared emergencies; same prices and offers for every tender (P10)

threat_event: Owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the only phone, so nobody can sell by card, order stock, or reach the processor and customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single person holds every role and credential; portal second factor on one phone; family member knows only the shared PIN
treatment_plan: Family member's own POS login and open-and-close sheet; sealed recovery codes; ask the processor and distributor about a designated contact (P05)

threat_event: Processor or internet outage stops card and EBT sales for part of a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single terminal on a single internet line
existing_controls: Cash sales continue; outages so far lasted under 2 hours
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep a printed price list and paper tally; ask the processor whether the terminal can use a phone hotspot

threat_event: Business files and customer exports on the laptop are lost to device failure or ransomware with no backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup or version history for laptop files and the consumer file account
existing_controls: Vendors back up the store, POS, and accounting data
treatment_plan: Keep business files only in a business file plan with version history; delete exports that are no longer needed

threat_event: A card data compromise is not recognized, or the processor's 24-hour notice term or a Florida deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training; notice term unknown before this assessment
treatment_plan: Adopt and print the P08 runbook and contacts; walk through it with the outside IT helper

threat_event: Continued PCI DSS non-compliance: monthly fees keep accruing, and after a compromise the processor passes on card brand costs or ends card acceptance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAQs never completed; no scope description; portal answers left out phone orders
treatment_plan: Correct the portal's screening answers; confirm the SAQ types with the processor; complete both SAQs with evidence

threat_event: Hurricane or long power outage closes the store for several days
existing_controls: Online store and portals are cloud-hosted and reachable from home
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop and tablet home when a hurricane warning is issued; follow POL-01 11.3 for perishables and prices
